title: Mork & Mindy white egg as a hint of hidden knowledge
summary: Jake Barber tells of Mork & Mindy white egg as a hint of hidden knowledge, about 1970s at US television, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The story goes and they show it in the preview of that show and it's part of every show is this white egg. He flew to Earth

plain: A man named Jake Barber, who says he helped retrieve a UFO with his helicopter, brings up Mork & Mindy, a 1970s American TV comedy where Robin Williams played an alien. Barber points out that in every episode the alien flies to Earth in a white egg, and he suggests this may hint that someone knew about real egg-shaped craft. If true, it would mean hidden knowledge was slipped into popular television.
